target_customer: SRE and on-call engineering teams at software companies
problem: Production incidents need 30 to 90 minutes of manual investigation across logs, metrics and code before the cause is found, which inflates time to resolution.
product_category: AI incident investigation and root cause analysis

founders.name: Yasmin Dunsky
founders.background_notes: Founded an ecosystem training female software developers in Israel

founders.name: Roei Schuster
education: Cornell and Tel Aviv University, PhD

founders.name: Tom Tytunovich
prior_employers: New York nonprofit for homeless people (CTO)

technical_complexity.rationale: An agent must query logs, metrics, databases and code across tools like Datadog and New Relic and reach accurate root causes, which is hard for a three person team in 2023 with early LLMs.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with customer observability stacks create some lock-in, but large observability vendors and LLM based agents were easy to replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Observability and incident vendors are the adjacent players; this record found no dated source showing what they shipped, so the outcome is not established.

market_need_then: Incident response is a recurring cost for engineering teams and mean time to resolution is a standard metric; the 2023 arrival of capable LLMs created a way to automate first investigation. No quantified spend figure was found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or founder material about the brand was found; the name is memorable and playful but not shown to have driven growth.

outcome_analysis: Wild Moose is early and active. It went through YC in Winter 2023 and emerged from stealth in October 2025 with a $7M seed led by iAngels, with named early customers such as Wix, Redis and Lemonade reported by Network World. The tailwind is LLM capability applied to a costly on-call workflow; the open risk is that observability vendors add similar agents.
notes: Aggregators report total raised of $7.5M and founding in 2022 (one calls it formerly Context AI) and Tel Aviv; YC lists New York and the YC batch is Winter 2023. These are unverified.
